text:
Olivia: Quick brag/shame: built a collapsible standing desk out of two milk crates and a door. photo incoming. :milk_glass:
Marcus: definitely photos or it didn’t happen :camera_with_flash:
Olivia: https://example.com/milkcrate-desk.jpg  laptop balanced, external keyboard on the door, cat supervising. surprisingly ergonomic for 10 minutes. :cat2:
Kei: 10/10 for ingenuity. tip: put a silicone trivet under the laptop to stop it sliding when you stand. also secure the door hinge with a strap.
Olivia: noted. pro tip request: my Wi-Fi drops when I move to stand, like magic. anyone else lose signal when relocating 2 meters?
Marcus: moving changes the RF environment. if you have a mesh satellite, move it higher. otherwise try tethering phone for the call.
Kei: also, check for USB wifi adapter drivers if you use one. cheap adapters can be flaky when laptop position changes.
Olivia: tethering saved the call. will try adapter as backup. also, does anyone have a recommendation for a cheap clip-on mic? my headset is in another fort.
Marcus: Fifine K669 clone on sale sometimes, or a cheap lav mic from amazon. plug-and-play USB is easiest.
infra-bot: FYI: Regional ISP maintenance scheduled 2026-09-14 04:00 UTC. Short blips possible.
Olivia: of course maintenance. perfect timing for my improvised desk launch. :tada:
sticker-bot: :thumbsup: added a sticker to Olivia's photo
Kei: embrace the chaos  call it "pop-up HQ" and sell a blog post.
Marcus: also label the milk crates before you lose them in the garage. learned that the hard way.
Olivia: labeling done. next iteration: attach a cable management mug holder. wish me luck. :hammer_and_wrench:
